tools.name: find_kids_events
tools.description: Search upcoming family and kids events near a US city on KidsEventsThisWeek.com: library story times, museum days, camps, festivals, church kids programs and more. Useful for finding what to do with children this week, this weekend or on a given day. Takes a city and state, or a 5-digit US ZIP code (if both are given the ZIP is used; a ZIP is matched to the nearest city we cover). Returns at most 10 events, closest to the city first (0-5 miles, then 5-15, then farther) and soonest first within each distance, spread across the requested days, each with the date, start time, venue, price (free or paid), age range when known, a one-line summary and a link to the event page. Dates default to the next 7 days and the window never exceeds 31 days. Only events that start inside the window are returned.

city.description: City name, for example "Plano" or "San Antonio". Give city and state, or a zip.

state.description: US state as a two-letter code or full name, for example "TX" or "Texas".

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code, for example "75034". An alternative to city and state.

radius_miles.description: How far from the city center to look, in miles. Default 25, maximum 50.

start_date.description: First day to search, YYYY-MM-DD, in the city's local time. Default today.

end_date.description: Last day to search, YYYY-MM-DD. Default 6 days after the start date. The window is capped at 31 days.

age_years.description: Age of the child in years. Keeps events that fit that age and events with no stated age range.

free_only.description: Set true to return only free events.

category.description: Optional topic filter: storytime (library story times), toddlers (ages 0-4), camps, church (church kids programs), or a holiday (halloween, christmas, easter, fourth-of-july).

tools.name: get_kids_event
tools.description: Get the details of one event from KidsEventsThisWeek.com by its id, which is the last part of the event link (the text after /event/). Returns the date and time, venue, full address, organizer, price, age range, a short summary and the link to the event page, which has the full description and registration details.

id.description: The event id or slug (the text after /event/ in the event link), or the full event page link.

tools.name: list_best_around_guides
tools.description: List the "Best Around" guides for a US city on KidsEventsThisWeek.com: hand-picked guides to local parks, playgrounds, splash pads, museums, free Christmas lights and similar places for families. Useful for finding places to go in general rather than events on a given week. Returns the guide title and link for each, up to 12.

state.description: US state as a two-letter code or full name.
